name: agent-durbar
description: Command center to see, chat with and coordinate coding agents (Copilot CLI first) in an office-style view.

scripts.test: npm run test:permissions && npm run test:attachments && npm run test:vscode && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:history && npm run test:vscodechat && npm run test:folders && npm run test:events && npm run test:markdown && npm run test:rooms && npm run test:url && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:toolstats && npm run test:devhooks && npm run test:credits && npm run test:toolusage && npm run test:usagestore && npm run test:about && npm run test:usagetotals && npm run test:dialog && npm run test:modelswitch && npm run test:simmodel && npm run test:copilotmodel && npm run test:places && npm run test:floors && npm run test:mood && npm run test:theme && npm run test:userthemes && npm run test:scenekits && npm run test:usagedoc
scripts.test:runtime: tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-runtime.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-detect.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-router.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-adapter-contract.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-agentops.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-codex-modes.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-claude-modes.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-codex-map.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-claude-map.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-codex-rpc.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-redact.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-usage-012.js && node dist-scripts/scripts/test-sc004.js
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.js && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.js && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.js darwin-arm64 && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.js darwin-x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.js win32-x64 && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.js linux-x64 && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.check:model: npm run build && xvfb-run -a sh -c "L=\$(mktemp); DURBAR_USER_DATA=\$(mktemp -d) DURBAR_SIM=15 DURBAR_SIM_FREEZE=1 DURBAR_DRIVER=\$PWD/scripts/shots-model.js electron . --no-sandbox 2>&1 | tee \$L; grep -q 'model] all checks passed' \$L"
scripts.check:dialog-focus: npm run build && xvfb-run -a sh -c "L=\$(mktemp); DURBAR_USER_DATA=\$(mktemp -d) DURBAR_SIM=15 DURBAR_SIM_FREEZE=1 DURBAR_DRIVER=\$PWD/scripts/check-dialog-focus.js electron . --no-sandbox 2>&1 | tee \$L; grep -q 'dialog-focus] all checks passed' \$L"
scripts.check:themes: for t in clean-office corporate retro durbar-indian durbar-european durbar-japanese; do DURBAR_THEME=$t OFFICE_THEME=$t npm run check:office || exit 1; done && OFFICE_USER_THEME=scripts/fixtures/themes/check-user.json npm run check:office
